title: Extract Cargo output selection policy from the shared test launcher
outcome: Keep the launcher orchestration readable by moving the coherent Cargo output selection/argument/path policy into a small module when coordinated scope permits, preserving the current root-local/warm-cache policy and all existing launcher contracts. This follow-up grants no new registry, namespace, cleanup or provenance authority.
acceptance: The coherent Cargo output policy has a documented module boundary and the launcher retains only orchestration, without changing behavior or dependency ownership.
Relevant launcher tests and required independent review pass on the extracted input.
